_notes: Vanilla block item placement, recorded by the asset generator's capture-scenarios (Java/PlacementFixtures.java, CaptureFixtures=placement) on a headless dedicated server in a flat world of air. contexts are the input: setup blocks are set at offsets from target without updates, then a survival player standing at player, with the context's yaw, pitch and sneaking, uses each block item (a stack of two, in the main hand) on the clicked block (an offset from target) at face and cursor (on the clicked block, 0 to 1 on each axis), through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn. items holds, for every block item in registry order, one result per context: each block within two of target that changed, as dx,dy,dz=state relative to target, joined with ';', in y, z, x order. A state names only the properties that differ from its block's default. An empty result means nothing changed.
